reason: Explicit user request to implement ParadeDB in Go and measure performance plus skill matching quality.
scope: New service-backend reference; independent from spent dense-programme/flat-BM25F variants.
retrieval: ParadeDB 0.25.6 defaults; match OR; name+description+digest+triggers+body; Unicode tokenizer; NUL replaced by space in indexed text only; top 50; deterministic score desc/URN asc; independent index/IDF per tenant/repo/snapshot; metadata fields pdb.literal; URN COLLATE C
policy: Go port of shared policy/filter/RRF/scope/closure/select with 144 conformance cases. w_dense=0. No GPU in this reference.

datasets.dev: 1000 frozen SKILLRET train queries and train skill pool

scope_setting: _root on labelled public corpora; authored case.node on Meridian; no gold-derived scope
baseline: Current unchanged local CLI F0 with same input cards, nodes, weights, queries and scopes; no dense
metrics: Existing tools/eval/metrics.py and skillret.evaluate_full. Retrieval order for hit@1/nDCG/recall; selected injection for all_required@4/HSR. Report answered denominators, paired bootstrap 1000 resamples, and separately labelled all-answerable diagnostic.
test_b_budget: Keep budget_constrained in full report, exclude only that predeclared impossible-25-skills stratum from completeness comparison.
latency: Same 200 frozen DEV texts on 6006 document pool; HTTP c1/c4 and fresh c1/burst fresh c4; all attempts/errors; whole-client p95 <=400, server p95 <=300; loopback only. Fresh clients read their token file inside the timed process.
acceptance: Report every outcome. No production sign-off or dense-quality conclusion. No retrieval/policy tuning after test labels are evaluated.
